profile.name: Samantha Cho
profile.summary: Board-certified physician assistant with four years in emergency and urgent care. I see 25 to 30 patients a shift, work well in a busy department, and take the time to explain discharge plans so patients actually follow them.

descriptions: See 25 to 30 patients a shift in a 48-bed emergency department with about 70,000 visits a year
Perform procedures including laceration repair, splinting, incision and drainage, and joint reductions
Helped write the chest pain pathway for low-risk patients, cutting average stays by 2 hours
Precept PA students from two programs, about six students a year
Treated about 35 patients a shift across three urgent care clinics
Read X-rays with radiology overreads and managed common fractures and sprains
Started a same-day callback list for abnormal lab results, cutting missed follow-ups
Took vitals, drew blood, ran EKGs and helped with procedures for about 40 patients a shift
Clinical rotations: emergency medicine, family medicine, surgery, pediatrics, psychiatry
